slots.visualRecipe: Near-white tinted ground (light value, low saturation, two soft lighter radial blooms). A centred medium-weight sans line starts about 0.70 of frame width and 0.12 high and ends as a two-line block about 0.53 wide. The defining words carry the single accent colour; the others stay ink. End state: the line is complete and a full-frame soft texture from the incoming shot rises over it from below.
slots.motionRecipe: Words pop whole at about 0.07-0.17 s intervals (a single frame each, 2-3 frame settle); the line re-centres on every word. Pull back about 30% over 1.1 s, sine-like. From 1.6 s the covering layer rises from the bottom; the type exits up and out on power2.inOut.
slots.soundRecipe: Music starts at full energy on frame 0 (a steady pulse near 112 BPM in the reference). No effects; the word pops ride the pulse loosely and may fall between beats.

copySlot.purpose: Category promise naming the product's kind, with 2-3 accent words

slots.visualRecipe: The product's world as a designed 3D place: the hero character inside the world's signature set piece, subject centred about 0.55 of width, 4-6 tool icons in orbit. End state: framed tight on the character.
slots.motionRecipe: Revealed from under the covering layer. A slow push that accelerates (circ.in) for the last 4-5 frames into a hard cut.
slots.soundRecipe: Same bed. The cut lands within 1-2 frames of a beat.

slots.visualRecipe: Low over-the-shoulder close-up of the hero at work, warm rim light from a single side, the orbiting icons out of focus behind.
slots.motionRecipe: Continues the incoming push and brakes, speed halving each frame for about 4 frames. Exit: bleach to the ground colour over 8 frames (sine.inOut), from a single side first.

slots.visualRecipe: A two-word imperative centred on the near-white ground, ink only, about 0.45 wide and 0.13 high.
slots.motionRecipe: First word hard-in on the frame after the bleach, second word about 0.23 s later; slow push-in.
slots.soundRecipe: The bed thins at this point, so let the music drop its transients for about a second around the next slot.

copySlot.purpose: The single action the product asks of the viewer

slots.role: reveal: character pops from the gap
slots.visualRecipe: The character's portrait in a circle, 0.32 of width, centred; the two words cropped at both frame edges.
slots.motionRecipe: A dot appears in the word gap, then the disc pops to full size in a single frame while the words fly to the edges and drift out on expo.out over about 0.4 s. Exit: hard cut to the next layout.
slots.soundRecipe: Music break (few transients). No effect needed; the pop is the accent.

slots.role: proof: the assistant proposes a plan
slots.visualRecipe: The real product thread at reading scale on the near-white ground: small avatar with a name pill at y 0.28, user bubble on the right in pale accent tint, assistant bubbles and cards on the left in white with soft shadows. Text about 0.035-0.045 of frame height. End state: a card with a short list and an offer to act.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut in on the shrunken avatar (3-frame settle). Messages land whole and settle in 3 frames, 0.5-1.5 s apart. The typing indicator stretches into a bar that the answer card wipes through (0.67 s, power3.out). Slow upward drift as the column grows.
slots.soundRecipe: The bed resumes. Optional soft pop per message landing at 0.3-0.5 level.

copySlot.purpose: A real user question and the product's real answer with a short list

slots.visualRecipe: The input field at hero scale: text about 0.11 of frame height, bar running off the left edge, soft accent glow behind the caret.
slots.motionRecipe: Camera scrolls off the previous card (power2.out, 0.5 s) as the field slides in from the right with a cursor that becomes an I-beam. Type at about 1.6 frames per character; the frame tracks the caret linearly. Newest word in accent, settling to ink. Hold about 0.9 s after the last character.
slots.soundRecipe: Music break for the camera move; typing starts as the pulse returns. Optional key ticks at 0.2-0.3.

copySlot.purpose: The user's delegating request, in their own voice

slots.visualRecipe: The far end of the same bar: voice icon and a circular accent send button about 0.23 of width.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard reframe sideways along the bar, which keeps its band and drift; hold about 1 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Cut on a transient or a frame after it.

slots.visualRecipe: The send circle becomes a portrait window, about 0.34 of width, centred. A two-line headline sits above and below it, the first line tucked behind the disc's top edge, the product name in accent. Line boxes about 0.51-0.55 wide, 0.17 high.
slots.motionRecipe: Button fill drains to the ground colour top-down in 5 frames; the character rises into the circle from below in 6 frames; words appear singly about 0.13-0.7 s apart. Push in about 12% to the end. Exit: fast push with blur, the type leaves top and bottom and the portrait floods to a glossy accent sphere (power2.inOut, about 0.25 s).
slots.soundRecipe: A transient on the drain; the flood breaks on a beat.

copySlot.purpose: The brand promise of handing the job over, ending on the product name

slots.visualRecipe: Same thread grammar: the sphere becomes the header avatar; the request bubble, a short success answer with a tick, then a longer unprompted suggestion from the assistant.
slots.motionRecipe: Messages land whole and settle in 3 frames; about 1 s apart; slow drift. Exit: a circle about 0.25 of width opens in the middle and grows past the corners in about 0.57 s (power2.inOut).
slots.soundRecipe: The bed thins for about 2.5 s before the iris; the next section starts inside the iris.

copySlot.purpose: Confirmation that the delegated work is finished, plus a single proactive suggestion

slots.visualRecipe: Top-down view of the same set piece, subject dead centre about 0.18 of width; no UI, no type.
slots.motionRecipe: Slow pull-back, power1.out, cubic-bezier(0.383, 0.602, 0.522, 0.679), about 1.2 s. Exit: the tagline wipes across it.
slots.soundRecipe: New musical section underneath; let it breathe.

slots.visualRecipe: A short tagline in the film's sans, accent colour at first, settling to a single centred line 0.63 wide and 0.14 high on the near-white ground, then ink.
slots.motionRecipe: Letters fly in from frame height (a single glyph spans the frame), sweep across in about 9 frames and settle to the line on expo.out by about 0.75 s. Re-colour accent to ink by about 0.7 s after entry; spacing opens from touching to normal. Then shrink and fade to about 25%.
slots.soundRecipe: Land the full-frame letters on the loudest hit of the track.

copySlot.purpose: Short tagline that names the benefit

slots.visualRecipe: A single accent-colour brush monogram centred on the near-white ground, about 0.18 wide and 0.21 high; nothing else.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard-in at full size with motion blur, then writes on its strokes while shrinking from about 0.35 to 0.14 of height in 0.47 s (expo.out). Holds still to the last frame; no fade.
slots.soundRecipe: The music ends about 0.45 s before the last frame and the mark holds over silence.

rhythm.cutGrid: No beat-locked cut grid: corrected boundaries hit beats at chance (0.25 against 0.30). Put pivots where the bed thins (about 7.7-8.6 s, 14.6-15.9 s, 26-28.5 s in the reference), land the type-spectacle wipe on the loudest hit, and give reading-scale UI 5-6.5 s holds and morphs 0.5-1.2 s. Of 12 boundaries, use only 3-4 hard cuts; the rest become morphs, wipes or camera moves.

style: High-key pastel world: near-white tinted ground, a single saturated accent, ink type, a warm tactile character in feature-animation 3D, and real product UI at reading and hero scale. A single circle carries the eye through every change. Centred medium-weight sans with the accent on the defining words.

keep: A single recurring circle as the through-line: hero disc, avatar, send button, portrait window, sphere, iris
Two UI scales: the thread at reading scale for the product's work, the input at hero scale for the user's action
Only 3-4 hard cuts in 35 s; the rest become morphs, wipes and camera moves
Accelerate into a cut and brake out of it
Accent colour only on defining words; type centred; large empty ground
Pivots placed where the music thins; type spectacle on the loudest hit; the mark held still over the music's end, no fade
Words that open to reveal the thing they invoke
mustChange: product UI (use the real product's own interface)
palette hue (keep the light-ground and single-accent structure)
